A '''battle''' at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Columus/Legends|Columus]] occurred during the [[Imperial Skirmishes]], a desperate attempt by the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Moff Council]] and the [[replacement warlord]]s to turn the tide in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

At the same time as the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] under [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] was seeking to expand into the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] at the [[Battle of Champala]], the [[replacement warlord]]s under [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] were attempting to break out of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. However, they were unable to stay unified, and [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] led the [[New Republic Fourth Fleet]] in a series of perimeter campaigns that pushed back their territory.

[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala]] attacked the New Republic Fourth Fleet at [[Columus/Legends|Columus]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Bel Iblis tried to use a pair of [[CC-7700 frigate/Legends|CC-7700 frigates]] (equipped with [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]]) to capture Daala onboard her command ship, [[Scylla (frigate)|''Scylla'']]. However, Daala had the ''Scylla'' ram the forward CC-7700, destroying it and allowing her to escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

The [[Scylla (frigate)|''Scylla'']] escaped by retreating into a blind [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump,<ref name="Atlas" /> and Daala wasn't heard from again for at least twenty years.
